mappings.note: This verse (Deut 13:1 in Hebrew numbering) contains the command to keep all words without adding or subtracting. This text is completely absent from the provided OSMAIN text, which begins directly with the scenario of a false prophet.
Translation v2 covers the first half of OSMAIN v1 ('When a prophet... gives you a sign'). It stops before the condition in OSMAIN v1/v2 about the sign coming to pass.

Translation v3 combines the end of OSMAIN v1 ('...and he says') with the beginning of OSMAIN v2 ('...and the sign... comes to pass'). The Hebrew structure flows from the prophet speaking about a sign, to the sign happening, to the call to follow other gods.
Translation v3 (Hebrew) corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v3 content: 'Do not listen... For the Lord tests you...'.
Translation v5 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v4 content: 'Follow the Lord... fear him... keep his commands...'.
Translation v6 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v5 content: 'That prophet shall die... for he spoke rebellion...'.
Translation v7 covers the list of relatives ('brother, son, daughter...') found in OSMAIN v6. It cuts off before the phrase 'in secret' and the start of the quote.

Translation v8 combines the end of OSMAIN v6 ('...in secret says: Let us go and serve other gods') with all of OSMAIN v7 ('gods of the peoples around you...'). The Hebrew text splits the sentence about 'other gods' across these two verses.
Translation v9 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v8 content: 'Do not yield... do not spare him...'.
Translation v10 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v9 content: 'You shall kill him... your hand first...'.
Translation v11 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v10 content: 'Stone him... because he sought to lead you away...'.
Translation v12 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v11 content: 'All Israel shall hear and fear...'.
Translation v13 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v12 content: 'When you hear it said about one of your cities...'.
Translation v14 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v13 content: 'Worthless men have gone out... and seduced the inhabitants...'.
Translation v15 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v14 content: 'You shall inquire... and if it is true...'.
Translation v16 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v15 content: 'You shall strike the inhabitants... devote it to destruction...'.
Translation v17 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v16 content: 'Gather the spoil... burn the city...'.

Translation v18 covers the first part of OSMAIN v17 ('Nothing devoted shall cleave to your hand... so that the Lord turns from his anger...'). It stops before the final clause about making you numerous.

Translation v19 combines the end of OSMAIN v17 ('...and show you mercy and make you numerous as he swore to your fathers') with all of OSMAIN v18 ('When you listen to the voice of the Lord...' ). The Hebrew text splits the final promise across these two verses.

extraContent.description: The entire verse (Deut 13:1) is missing from OSMAIN. It contains the command: 'You shall diligently keep all that I command you... do not add to it or take away from it.' This text precedes the false prophet scenario in standard Bibles but is absent here.
